Title: Ubiquiti's $99 Vape Detector is actually pretty good
Description:
Since learning about the effects of high CO2 concentration on attention and cognitive performance—especially at levels much higher than 2000ppm—I've started monitoring CO2 and other air quality indicators in my house, at my studio, and even on the road.
I have a few other air quality monitors I'll be covering in the future, but today I wanted to focus on one I only heard about in the comments on a recent video tearing down a cheap no-name 'Air Quality Detector' from Amazon.

Title: Introducing Seed Search
Description:
Mwmbl is continuing to develop its search engine with new features and ways for the community to get involved. One of these features is Seed Search, which helps improve search results while expanding Mwmbl’s own search index.
What is Seed Search?
Seed Search helps Mwmbl find relevant web pages using its existing search index and external search providers. It can help users find pages that Mwmbl’s own index might not have found yet.
